form.title: Passport details
form.intro: Enter the details exactly as they appear on the passport. All fields are required.

fields.documentHint: A scan or photo of the passport's data page: PDF, PNG or JPEG. One file.

errors.invalidDate: Enter a full date as YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2024-01-15
errors.expiryNotAfterIssue: The expiry date must be after the issue date ({{issueDate}})
errors.unsupportedType: Only PDF, PNG or JPEG files are accepted
errors.readFailed: We couldn't read this file. Try another one.
